Docs Bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 - 'fix(embeddings): header param name + schema'
Marta: heads-up — noticed two things in the embeddings API ref that don't match runtime:
Marta: 1) curl examples set header "X-Model" but runtime expects "model" in body. docs show both variants
Marta: 2) response schema example shows "embedding": [0.1, 0.2] (singular field) but the actual response is {"embeddings": [[...]]} (array)
Raj: thanks. I hit the runtime locally and can confirm the response is embeddings (plural) for batched requests
Sam: also the Python SDK snippet in the examples currently does `client.embeddings(model='x', input='text')` which is outdated to the new signature `client.embeddings.create(model=..., input=[...])`
Marta: yeah that's the mismatch. We should update: endpoint params, curl header, response sample, and the Python snippet. Also add a tiny migration note in the top-level embeddings doc.
Raj: I'll push a patch to the docs PR to fix the schema + examples. planning to:
Raj: - change curl to body JSON with "model" field
Raj: - change response example to embeddings: [[...]] and update schema (items -> array of arrays)
Raj: - add unit test in docs repo that validates sample JSON against schema
Sam: I'll update the SDK snippet in the same PR. will include this Python example:
Sam: ```python
Sam: from redwood import Client
Sam: client = Client()
Sam: resp = client.embeddings.create(model="text-embed-1", input=["a short sentence", "another one"])
Sam: print(resp.embeddings[0])
Sam: ```
Kevin: small nit — our existing JS snippet shows single input (string). should we standardize docs to always show list form to avoid confusion?
Marta: +1 to list form. add a note: single string is accepted but wrapped as list by SDK
Kevin: ok. Also add a changelog bullet in the top of doc: "Breaking: embeddings.* response field name changed to embeddings (array) — update SDK usage"
Marta: @Raj @Sam can you aim to have PR updates by EOD? I'll review and merge after CI passes.
Raj: yep, will have commits up within the hour. linking branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/tree/fix/embeddings-headers
Sam: pushed SDK snippet update to PR comment, will add file change after Raj updates schema
Marta: thanks team! :thumbsup: I'll also add a redirect from old example path to the updated page to avoid external links breaking
